cold_notice_past: Come as soon as you can and light the fire. It won't be fully hot at the start.
season_soon_note: Season opens {date}. Here are the first days.
season_after_body: Thanks for coming, see you next winter.
info_location_body: [PLATZHALTER] Where the sauna wagon stands and how to get there.
info_heating_body: [PLATZHALTER] Already hot: someone was there before you and the stove is running. Cold start: nobody is before you, so you light the fire yourself. Come at the time shown, so the sauna is warm when your time starts. How to light the fire goes here.
info_keybox_body: [PLATZHALTER] You get the keybox code by email 24 hours before your start. Where the box is and where the key goes afterwards goes here.
info_cancelling_body: [PLATZHALTER] If you can't come, send us an email. The address is at the bottom of every page.
privacy_operator_body: [PLATZHALTER] Who runs the sauna and is responsible for your details.
privacy_contact_body: [PLATZHALTER] How to reach us with questions about your details.
privacy_purposes_heading: What we use your details for
privacy_purposes_body: [PLATZHALTER] Name: so we can match the booking at the sauna. Email: for the confirmation and the keybox code. Mobile: only in case we need to call you at short notice.
privacy_retention_body: [PLATZHALTER] We delete your details 30 days after the season ends.
privacy_backups_body: [PLATZHALTER] We back up the data every night in Switzerland. Deleted details can stay in these backups for up to [period], then they are gone there too.
privacy_tracking_body: [PLATZHALTER] There is no tracking and no third-party analytics. The site sets only one cookie, for your language. Whether you chose the light or dark design stays in your browser.
error_conflict: Someone just took {time}. Here's the day as it is now. Your details are still filled in.
error_past: {time} has already started. Please pick another time.
duration_unavailable_booking: {range} min not possible: next booking at {time}.
field_name_purpose: So we know whose booking it is at the wagon.
field_email_purpose: For your confirmation and the keybox code.
field_mobile_purpose: Only in case we need to call you at short notice.

booked_revisit: This is how it stood when you booked. We'll email you about any changes.
booked_keybox: You'll get the keybox code on {at}.
